## Packages

```{r}
# Install pacman once (if missing) and load it
if (!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman")

# Install (if missing) and load the packages for this lecture
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, # this is for data science
            janitor, # this is to clean data
            readxl, # to load xls
            here, # to ensure file paths
            naniar, # to deal with missing data
            palmerpenguins, # this is a dataset
            gtsummary) # this is to create nice tables
```

# Load dataset

```{r}
library(readxl) # this is to read Excel files
dirty_data <- read_excel(here::here("Lecture_2", "data", "dirty_data.xlsx"), skip = 1) # skip = 1 skips the title row
View(dirty_data)
```

# Data cleaning

```{r}
dirty_data |>
  glimpse()
```

```{r}
dirty_data |>
  summary()
```

```{r}
dirty_data |>
  get_dupes() # find duplicate rows (from janitor)
```

```{r}
# Remove empty rows and columns (where every value is NA)
dirty_data <- dirty_data |>
  janitor::remove_empty(c("rows", "cols"))
```

```{r}
# Count missing values in each column (from naniar)
dirty_data |>
  miss_var_summary()
```

## Select one column

```{r}
dirty_data$`First Name`
```

```{r}
# Plot missing values in each column (from naniar)
dirty_data |>
  gg_miss_var()
```

```{r}
# Show missing values for the whole dataset (from naniar)
dirty_data |>
  vis_miss()
```

```{r}
# Count missing values in each row (from naniar)
dirty_data |>
  miss_case_summary()
```

# Clean the data

```{r}
# Make column names lowercase with underscores (from janitor)
clean_data <- dirty_data |>
  clean_names()
```

```{r}
# All cleaning steps in one pipe: load, fix names, drop empty and constant columns
cleaned_data <-
  readxl::read_excel(here("Lecture_2", "data", "dirty_data.xlsx"), skip = 1) |>
  clean_names() |>
  remove_empty(which = c("rows", "cols")) |>
  remove_constant()
```

# Penguins

```{r}
# Number of rows and columns
dim(penguins)
```

```{r}
# Summary statistics for each column
summary(penguins)
```

```{r}
# Show missing values in the penguins data (from naniar)
penguins |>
  vis_miss()
```

```{r}
# Count penguins by species and island
table(penguins$species, penguins$island)
```
